dct_title_s: Vegetation Areas (Digital Map Database of China)
dct_description_sm: Abstract: This polygon coverage includes general classes of vegetation features found throughout China. These features include mangrove forests, economically exploited forests (bamboo, coffee, etc.), shrub and grassland areas. Not all vegetation types found in China are represented in this coverage.

Purpose: This data is intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and to provide users with geographic data for cartography, environmental monitoring, management and impact analysis, land use, economic analysis and associated areas of geographic analysis. Data can be used with geographic information systems (GIS) software to display and analyze information on land cover and associated areas of interest, or to provide a basemap to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data.
